notes.title: Devlog #14 - The most important PART (let's talk about PARTS) 🛠️
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Mechanics![/h1]
We know you’re passionate about two wheels, but today we’ve got something special that bridges the gap between motorcycles and cars. 🏍️🚗 Whether you’re tinkering with your bike in the garage or curious about the inner workings of four-wheeled machines, our latest devlog dives into the art of creating realistic vehicle parts. From bolts to engine blocks, it’s a process that applies to both worlds of speed and mechanics.

When it comes to Rally Mechanic Simulator, it’s all about the details. Creating realistic car parts is the core of our game, and today we’re excited to take you behind the scenes to show how we bring those parts to life—from the first concept to the final 3D model.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/e3c4fef430ee7f4940fbb4bc4a37a6a5743decd8.png[/img]

Every car part starts with thorough research. Our artists dive into photos, technical drawings, and real-life examples to understand the exact shapes, sizes, and materials needed. This stage is crucial for understanding shapes, sizes, and materials. Using tools like Blender, Maya, and Substance 3D Painter, we craft each part step-by-step, paying close attention to how light interacts with different surfaces, ensuring every bolt, screw, and panel feels authentic. Once the model is shaped, we fine-tune every detail, from bolts to textures, and then optimize it to keep the game running smoothly. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/257495ae8065edb270d7183d491a54a3494fbb80.gif[/img]

The time needed to model a part can vary. Simple parts might take a few hours, while complex ones can require up to two weeks. We balance accuracy and performance, relying on detailed references to ensure our models look and feel true to life. Many of our artists have spent time working with real car components, so they have a good sense of what details matter the most. Their mechanical experience adds an extra layer of authenticity to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/fd79843d03aa82751d3dd1fdf19d7c6c03c82121.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/69c6d1d8106cf6e2c3fd662b2d49a2d76968d2bf.png[/img]

Modeling challenging parts like engine blocks requires a blend of creativity and precision. These components are filled with tiny details that must look accurate while keeping the game running smoothly. To achieve this, we often use techniques like normal mapping, which allows us to create detailed textures without straining performance. Our team’s hands-on experience with real car parts helps us make informed choices, ensuring our models not only look good but also function correctly in-game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/2ddafe3c747abdb06d82393ed9c6244320508896.gif[/img]

Our workflow has evolved to make the process more efficient. We now use shared materials for texturing, making updates quicker, and keeping everything consistent. We’ve also refined our optimization techniques, allowing us to deliver stunning visuals without sacrificing performance. Each new model we create builds on the lessons we've learned, helping us reach higher standards of quality.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/1970ef5fa1d2673afdd3a3ae06969a9db0d2cfcf.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/fc13bf3b0eff446fe35112a8a7add511ec1d2710.png[/img]

Creating realistic and engaging car parts is an ongoing journey for our team. We’re constantly refining our techniques, learning from each model we create, and pushing the limits of what’s possible in the Rally Mechanic Simulator. Your feedback is crucial to us, and every suggestion helps us improve and bring you the best experience possible. We can’t wait to share more about our process, new features, and exciting updates we have in store. Stay tuned for more insights into the making of the game, and as always, we’d love to hear what you think! Join the conversation in the comments below or on our Discord. [b]Thank you for being a part of this journey, and see you in the garage![/b]

notes.title: Something tasty for fans of Motorcycle Mechanic Simulator!
notes.content:
[h2]How's it going, Mechanics? 🛠️[/h2]

We want to extend a huge thank you to everyone who played the [b]Prologue of Motorcycle Mechanic Simulator[/b]! Your support, feedback, and enthusiasm have been invaluable, and we're thrilled to have you with us on this journey. Your passion has motivated us to keep pushing the boundaries, and now we're excited to share a preview of what we have in store for you in our next game - Rally Mechanic Simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/ec93741758f3d81b2fbb5fef95b43c8f38fcc94f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/5f21572511a9fb3d2068c301e834a2a0415d1046.gif[/img]
[h1]Unmatched Realism in Every Detail [/h1]
Every car is designed to reflect the true intricacies of a rally vehicle. From the textured surfaces of the bodywork to the fine details of each mechanical part - every element is carefully crafted to bring the car to life. The inner components, like the engine and suspension, are equally realistic, showcasing the complexity of rally cars. With realistic lighting, every curve, bolt, and surface is highlighted, making the cars shine with authenticity. The result is a highly immersive experience, where each vehicle feels like it’s ready to take on the toughest rallies, with a level of detail that makes it almost feel like you could reach out and touch it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/44fde05c1777983dfc479efa8ffe9fa96d5314ff.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/d7b3716ddc55cf6e1c3e071fab4dce82ec0ddcc2.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/a8dde0bcdddb2abecee6830e8e4bbeeb233bb993.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/a43f7e7314bd70db5b417d8295660eca5cb210c3.gif[/img]
[h1]New locations to fine-tune every car [/h1]
[b]Paint Shop:[/b] Customize and personalize every rally car that comes into your care. The Paint Shop is fully equipped with a wide range of colors, textures, and finishes, allowing you to create unique designs that stand out on the track. Whether it’s a simple touch-up or a complete makeover, your creativity is the only limit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/2d4b6b54c2a9778640c403c9455d9b387de55444.gif[/img]
[b]Dyno Testing Room:[/b] Ever wonder if all that hard work paid off? The Dyno Testing Room is where you’ll find out. Strap the car in, fire up the engine, and put your modifications to the test. Measure power output, torque, and other vital stats to fine-tune each car to perfection. It’s the ultimate performance challenge for every dedicated mechanic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/1b33bcd248087a7b8bd871c62641d8cb229b6173.gif[/img]
[b]Diagnostics Center:[/b] Dive deeper into the technical side of rally car maintenance with our all-new Diagnostics Center. Utilize advanced scanning tools and diagnostic equipment to pinpoint issues, optimize performance, and ensure every vehicle is race-ready. This new area gives you a more hands-on and detailed approach to troubleshooting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/a8dde0bcdddb2abecee6830e8e4bbeeb233bb993.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/6409bac08509d6d7a33078a43dbcd17545682c33.gif[/img]
[h1]Enhanced Lighting & Visuals [/h1]
We’re introducing a brand-new lighting system that adds depth and realism to every corner of your workshop. From the gleam of polished metal to the shadows cast by your tools, the improved lighting brings out the finest details and creates a more immersive and atmospheric environment. Expect your garage to feel more alive and authentic than ever before.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/9575a72142260e9925b5c1ddd93d8cfd47aeb727.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059776/7da7871aff5b86cddcd7b31f003c51051a1bc4db.gif[/img]

[h1]Wishlist the Full Game![/h1]
We’re just getting started, and we have so much more planned for the full version of Rally Mechanic Simulator. Your wishlist adds make a huge difference, helping us reach more players and keep the excitement going. By adding RMS to your wishlist, you’ll stay up-to-date with all the latest announcements, updates, and special offers (you can be sure that for owners of [b]Motorcycle Mechanic Simulator 2021[/b] we will prepare a special attractive offer in the form of a bundle, as a thank you for your feedback).
Thank you once again for your incredible support and for being a crucial part of our community. We can't wait to share the full Rally Mechanic Simulator experience with you soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1588090/Rally_Mechanic_Simulator/

Remember, you still have the opportunity to check out the free version of Rally Mechanic Simulator.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002090/Rally_Mechanic_Simulator_Prologue/

Thanks folks and until the next one! High five!

notes.title: Rally Mechanic Simulator Prologue - DOWNLOAD NOW!
notes.content:
Motorcycles are cool and all, but what if you tossed 2 more wheels onto a vehicle and sent it on a dirt road?

We release Rally Mechanic Simulator prologue today - it’s already up [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002090/Rally_Mechanic_Simulator_Prologue/]HERE[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/a66b7f80afe7eca12e3a4f2b5d17f0de9c5cbd06.png[/img]

The game allows you to become a mechanic of a rally team. You’ll get to work on a car that highly resembles a rally car classic from the 90s. In this free version, you will be able to have the car go to 2 different rallies. While you won’t be driving the car there, you’ll need to make it driveable. A huge twist on the formula is introducing a timer when you fix the car between special stages - just like in real rallies. Your swiftness and expertise will weigh heavily on your team’s success.

There’s also a test drive mode with a leaderboard. And a small competition. The top 5 fastest people will get a Steam key for the full version of Rally Mechanic Simulator when it releases. You have time till the next Friday (the 19th of July), so hurry up and rally on!

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hey, Bikers!
We know it's been quiet around here for a while. We are working hard on the full game, which is now functionally closed, and we can tell you that the game is in the testing phase. The biggest struggle we had was with optimization. It was quite a challenge to render enviro, furniture, and motorcycles consisting of 400 parts. Our ultimate goal is to be able to bring the possibility of playing at the best settings to as many players as possible. We are satisfied with the optimization achieved at the moment, we have comparable performance with similar simulators, but we will still try to improve something there.
By the way, we have upgraded the engine version, which allowed us to achieve even better graphics. Take a look at some screenshots below.

notes.title: Patch #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/f7c907f9497ac7bffccabfa05d13325ced2bbdab.gif[/img]

Hey Bikers!
Again, we would like to thank you for all your comments and feedback. The goal of the prologue from the beginning was to uncover bugs, explore the flow of functionality, and gather expectations from players. So remember to join our discord, we'd love to hear more of your suggestions and comments. 

Today we are releasing a new patch. Here is what you can expect:
[list]
[*] We changed the flow of UI and tablet. Now you don't have to click every time through every app and shop. Now if you press TAB, it will save the last state and ESC will go back to the previous app/tablet view.
[*] We changed some flow of inventory, now when you select the part for painting, balancing, etc, you don't have to click accept. Everything is smoother and faster.
[*] We adjusted the lengths of some animations in UI so it's smoother and faster
[*] We added more red outlines and hints while disassembling
[*] We added the "bucket paint" feature to the paint table, you can now paint the whole part with one click
[*] We added multi sell feature to inventory, you can now select multiple parts and sell them in one click
[*] We changed some backend asset flow, so the game has better RAM performance now
[/list]
Fixes:
[list]
[*] We fixed an issue where fork legs were mounted in the air in Falcon
[*] We fixed an issue where the rim was not mounted with a tire in Falcon
[*] We fixed an issue where splash screen error caused people to have an infinite loading screen
[*] We fixed an issue, where sometimes a level was not loaded properly
[*] Fixed some issues with audio balancing
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes photo mode filters were not working properly
[*] Fixed some issues with shop categories
[*] Fixed some issues with modern rims not showing properly in machines
[/list]

We are investigating an issue where some people cannot open the game at all. It has something to do with graphics compatibility. We made some changes to this build, so it could be fixed but we need your feedback so we can do some more testing.

We are also working on some optimization issues, some people encounter heavy lag spikes while looking at motorcycles.

[url=https://discord.gg/Grj6R3B][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/72bf8e2fac955620f0d5ba32d77f23e589808b97.png[/img][/url]

We work non-stop!

notes.title: Prologue Devlog#1
notes.content:
Hey, Bikers!
Welcome to the prologue devlog for the first time. As some of you may have already read on the MMS21 game card, we are in the testing stage (we are now in the third iteration). For those who haven't seen the last two devlogs, we'd like to gather some information in a nutshell here.

Compared to the demo, we have made quite a few changes. First of all, we improved graphics. Check the comparison below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/f804b3bd26eac46b1b044b4d7a4b802db6b10786.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/ad9ed244743c73ba2e16d9956ebc756bdc0e29f0.png[/img]

In addition, we introduced the possibility of deep customization. We must admit that the options for customizing the look of the motorcycle have gone to the next level. We have made it possible to upload your own graphics as stickers. They can be scaled, reflected in the X and Y axis, rotated, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/d2a17e79ad5c2d9bd56363b130607d478c3f102a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/d28cb45137216db58da19de29d115202b0f4efd2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/53a5be78dca31060f5682315f160e32877e92456.gif[/img]

We decided that it would definitely be a cool feature to be able to take your motorcycle for a ride. We are still testing and testing, but we think we can make it to the prologue (still working on the look of the level).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/58c71afcc3e5b994a9d321fd3b402222e410c523.gif[/img]

We are also working on the character development tree and intensively testing the gameplay balance. There are a number of skills waiting for you to unlock, both active and passive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/2f3506bc3ff4ad7d11976745487ce9cd9720878c.gif[/img]

Speaking of skills. The game wouldn't be complete if there was a lack of fluid exchange, tire tread testing, diagnostics, etc. That is why our graphic designers have recently been working on assets necessary for the above-mentioned functionalities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/ad8e6a444b65005b3f01dab4a344f8ece6c43457.png[/img]

And of course, custom parts are being made all the time...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/8fed2b13e890a88248f8dedb121e55b6f10e8594.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/aa52fb06dce41040d616932cf754ef728c505cf7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/2380861f39ec93899c1e2b83112bfbc6f4966d58.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/5836e7a883d73f6d226cedee47a259ad30cc7ef6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/b6397902b85183663151313952b146ea9a3a030d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/77f747e8351f3e588acc6b85a83cc8729751df9b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/1feae827d3c6829a5677ca8e7f4e8ede2cf38ba1.png[/img]

What's more to add? Oh yes, we would really like to introduce the possibility of starting the motorcycle in the prologue to hear if and how it works. Hopefully, we will be able to do this in time for the prologue, but if not, it will be in the full game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40057099/590a9f46a7cf66ef1557c9c93324a23b69cca149.gif[/img]

Don't forget to hit us up on our [b]discord [/b]channel. There you can always talk to us and keep up to date with what's going on. C'mon & join! -> https://discord.gg/Grj6R3B
